items.headline: Standard Chartered Sees 600% Upside for $ENA
items.summary: Standard Chartered initiated coverage of $ENA with a $2 target, forecasting a 7x gain by end-2028 as $USDe scales toward $40B and Ethena's buyback program kicks in at $7.5B supply.

items.headline: $LIT Tumbles 22% as Robinhood Enters Perps Arena
items.summary: Lighter's $LIT dropped 22% over seven days after Robinhood unveiled in-app perpetual futures with up to 10x leverage, heating up competition in the onchain perps space.

items.headline: Same-Name Error Triggers 92% Liquidations in $BEN Perp
items.summary: Gate's $BEN perp market saw 92% liquidations after a same-name asset error tied to a scheduled dividend adjustment hit 200 accounts. Balance displays are being restored.

items.headline: $NEAR Intents Freezes $503K in Bitget Hack Funds
items.summary: $NEAR Intents says it froze $503,000 linked to the Bitget hack, with about $166,000 passing through its swap system. Bitget says NEAR Intents waived its recovery-bounty share.

items.headline: $BAL Sets Shutdown Dates After Holders Approve Wind-Down
items.summary: Balancer set shutdown dates after $BAL holders approved the protocol wind-down. About $52.4M remains in V2 and V3 pools, with treasury redemptions starting May 2027.
